product.name: DevDeploy Hub
product.description: A self-service DevOps platform for Kubernetes delivery, runtime health, logs, and observability.

landing.headline: Deploy faster. Observe smarter. Control Kubernetes with confidence.
landing.subheadline: DevDeploy Hub gives engineering teams a polished command layer for registering applications, triggering Kubernetes deployments, inspecting pod health, viewing logs, and watching the metrics that matter.
landing.previewSubtitle: Live release activity, pod health, and cluster pressure in one operational view.
landing.featuresSubtitle: A developer experience that feels fast for app teams and controlled for DevOps.

deployments.title: Self-service deployments
deployments.description: Trigger curated deployment workflows without waiting for a platform engineer to run commands.

gitops.title: GitOps-ready workflows
gitops.description: Model image tags, environments, rollout strategies, and approvals around real delivery practices.

kubernetes.title: Kubernetes visibility
kubernetes.description: See pods, namespaces, workloads, and cluster health without switching tools mid-incident.

observability.title: Observability built in
observability.description: Keep logs, metrics, deployment timelines, and runtime signals close to the release surface.
